cards.t: NYSE Owner ICE Plans U.S. Hyperliquid Perps via Trade[XYZ]
cards.b: The NYSE parent company, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), is partnering with and investing in Trade[XYZ] to bring regulated 24/7 perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid to the United States, pending CFTC approval.

per.HYPE: Saw significant price gains following the announcement of ICE and Trade[XYZ] bringing Hyperliquid perps to the U.S.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Polymarket Pauses Trading Following Security Incident
cards.b: Polymarket suspended trading and restricted relayer actions after a third-party provider breach led to drained user funds and millions stolen, with a suspected attacker wallet holding about $2.65 million in POL.

per.POL: Implicated as the token held in suspected exploiter wallets following the breach.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total exact financial loss and identity of the compromised third-party provider.
